name: spec-only-merge-leaves-main-db-stale
body: A SPEC-ONLY change-set — only `apg/layers/**` changed — merged by `apg project merge` leaves main's `db.lbug` carrying the merged authored nodes/edges, matching the `graph.jsonl` written by the same rebuild. Observable completion: (a) merge a spec-only change-set into main; (b) `apg query` on main returns every authored node/edge the branch committed; (c) a subsequent `apg scan` preserves main's DB as the merged spec. The splice path `rust.apg.splice.apply.apply` handles every authored/transient kind, and the seeded+spliced `db.lbug` `rust.apg.splice.publish.publish` swaps in carries the merged rows that its `graph.jsonl` carries.
